Construction

We specialize in commercial construction projects of all sizes, from retail stores, restaurants, and office fit-ups to ground-up commercial buildings. With an experienced team and a commitment to quality craftsmanship, we deliver functional, high-quality spaces built to meet your needs.

Our Services

Building with Care and Know-How

Expert commercial construction services for retail, office, restaurant, and ground-up building projects.

From retail stores to restaurants and offices, we know what it takes to get your space built right. Whether it's a full build-out or a brand-new building from the ground up, our team brings hands-on experience, attention to detail, and a strong work ethic to every job.

We handle a wide range of projects, from individual retail stores, restaurants, offices, and daycares to full ground-up construction of new strip plazas and pad site buildings. Our team includes experienced site superintendents, carpenters, framers, drywallers, painters, and general laborers—all highly skilled in retail construction, store fixturing, restaurant builds, office build-outs, and tenant fit-ups.

Project Types

  • Retail store construction and fixturing
  • Restaurant build-outs
  • Office fit-ups and renovations
  • Daycare facility construction
  • Tenant improvements and leasehold work
  • Ground-up strip plaza construction
  • Pad site building construction

Frequently Asked Questions

Ridgeway Services & Construction primarily serves clients throughout the Greater Toronto Area, Toronto, and Southern Ontario. However, our team has successfully completed projects beyond these areas, including locations across Ontario and Eastern Canada. Whether your project is nearby or requires travel, we're committed to bringing the same level of quality, communication, and expertise to every build.

Ridgeway Services & Construction specializes in commercial construction, renovations, tenant improvements, and design-build projects across a variety of industries. We've worked with businesses in childcare, retail, restaurants, offices, and professional spaces to bring their ideas from concept through completion.

Our team takes a collaborative approach, working closely with clients and partners to deliver high-quality spaces that meet their needs, timelines, and goals.

Yes, Ridgeway Services & Construction offers both design and construction services. Our team works closely with clients to create comprehensive solutions tailored to their needs and goals.

Yes. Ridgeway offers ongoing maintenance and support services after project completion. Our team helps clients maintain their commercial spaces through routine upkeep, repairs, and improvements, ensuring their investment continues to perform well over time.
